root_cause.text: The vulnerability stems from performing a `memset()` on the NPU command slot header before validating that the available buffer size is sufficient to hold the slot and command payload, resulting in an out-of-bounds write.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows `memset(npu_slot, 0, sizeof(*npu_slot))` being moved from before the size validation check `if (*size < sizeof(*npu_slot) + cmd_len)` to after it in functions like `aie2_cmdlist_fill_npu_cf`, ensuring the slot is only cleared when space is confirmed available.
